category: Application Library examples: Pipe Flow Module
description: Ready-made, documented example simulations installed with the Pipe Flow Module. Each lists its physics interfaces, couplings and study steps; solve one with comsol_run_example or adapt its Java build script.

tools.name: Borehole Heat Exchanger with Pipe Flow [Pipe Flow Module example]
tools.description: Application Library example of the Pipe Flow Module (Heat Transfer): Borehole Heat Exchanger with Pipe Flow. Physics interfaces: Heat Transfer in Porous Media (ht), Nonisothermal Pipe Flow (nipfl). Multiphysics couplings: PipeWallHeatTransfer. Study steps: Time Dependent. A ready model to start from for a similar simulation.
tools.usage: MCP: comsol_run_example("Pipe_Flow_Module/Heat_Transfer/borehole_heat_exchanger_pipe_flow") to solve it, comsol_example_info("borehole_heat_exchanger_pipe_flow", include_java=true) for its build script. COMSOL: File > Application Libraries > Pipe Flow Module > Heat Transfer > borehole heat exchanger pipe flow

parameters.name: ht
parameters.description: physics interface Heat Transfer in Porous Media (API type PorousMediaHeatTransfer)

parameters.name: nipfl
parameters.description: physics interface Nonisothermal Pipe Flow (API type NonisothermalPipeFlow)

tools.notes: Library path Pipe_Flow_Module/Heat_Transfer/borehole_heat_exchanger_pipe_flow; model file 1.6 MB. Documented Java build script available (rebuild with comsol_run_example method='java'). Requires the module licence to open and solve.
